app.name: ompide
search.title: Search Workspace
search.hint: Search literal text in the workspace, including unsaved buffers. Ignore files are respected; dependencies, build output, binary files and symlinks are skipped.
search.truncated: Results reached a search limit. Narrow the query or file path filter to see all matches.

search.replaceConfirm.one: Apply this replacement in one file?

search.bufferHint: Changes will be applied to editor buffers with Undo support. Save or Save All writes them to disk.
search.previewIncomplete: This preview is incomplete or cancelled. Narrow the query or path filter before applying replacements.
search.fileLimit: Showing the first 500 files. Type a longer path to narrow the results.
search.filesHint: Type part of a path; press Enter to open the selected file.
error.searchChanged: The workspace or source changed after this replacement preview. Refresh the search and review a new preview before applying.
error.searchBuffersLarge: Unsaved search buffers or replacement previews exceed the current size limit. Save some files or narrow the search first.
error.searchInvalid: Use a single-line search query and shorter search or replacement text.
build.timeout: The build exceeded its 15-minute time limit and was stopped.
build.outputLimit: The build exceeded its output limit and was stopped.
build.buffered: Compiler output appears when compilation finishes. You can keep editing or cancel the build.
build.truncated: The compiler output reached its size limit.
project.title: Configure Project…
project.truncated: Discovery reached 20,000 entries. Open a smaller workspace folder to see the remaining projects.
project.noManifest: This folder has no project manifest. Choose an entry point and include folders, then review pawn.json before creating it.
project.includes: Include folders (one per line, relative to workspace)
project.editHint: Edit the manifest to change entry points, profiles, include folders or compiler arguments. Save it, then refresh this configuration before building.
project.toolsHint: Bundled compiler: openmultiplayer/compiler 3.10.11. External compilers must match the pinned compatible version. No automatic downloads.
project.toolUnavailable: Tool unavailable; prepare the bundled tools or choose an executable.
project.buildHint: Build saves open files first. Only the selected entry is compiled; the output/main-name.amx artifact is replaced. Project scripts and runtime servers are not executed.
error.buildBusy: A build is running. Cancel it before changing projects, tools or workspaces.
error.projectRequired: Choose a project in Build → Configure Project before building.
error.projectChanged: The project configuration changed. Save the manifest and refresh Build → Configure Project, then review the selected entry before building.
error.projectInvalid: The project configuration is invalid. Check its entry point, named builds, include folders and compiler options, then refresh the configuration.
error.projectAmbiguous: This project folder contains multiple Pawn manifests. Keep one active pawn.json, pawn.yaml or pawn.yml, then refresh the configuration.
error.missingBuildTool: A build tool is missing. Prepare the pinned tools with npm run tools:prepare, or choose an existing compatible executable in Configure Project.
error.buildToolChecksum: A bundled build tool failed checksum verification. Prepare the pinned tools again or repair the installation.
error.buildToolVersion: Choose a compatible {tool} executable, version {expected}, in Configure Project.
error.compilerPathEncoding: The Windows compiler cannot reliably use Unicode paths. Move the project and compiler to paths containing only ASCII characters before building.
symbols.limit: Showing up to 500 symbols. Type to narrow the results.
layout.resizeHint: Drag or use arrow keys to resize. Double-click to reset.
explorer.title: Explorer
explorer.empty: Open a folder to explore your project.
explorer.name: Name
explorer.noFiles: This folder is empty. Create a file or folder to get started.
explorer.confirmTrashFile: Move “{name}” to the Recycle Bin? You can restore it using your operating system.
explorer.confirmTrashFolder: Move “{name}” and everything inside it to the Recycle Bin? You can restore it using your operating system.
editor.externalChanged: This file changed on disk. Your unsaved buffer has been kept. Reload it or save a copy.
editor.externalDeleted: This file was moved or deleted. Its buffer has been kept. Use Save As to restore it or save a copy.
editor.empty: Open a Pawn file or folder to start editing.
editor.desktopRequired: File and language features require the desktop application. Start it with npm run tauri -- dev.
recent.title: Recent workspaces
prompt.unsavedDetail: Your changes will be lost if you discard them.
status.crashLoop: Pawn language server repeatedly stopped. Restart it when ready.
settings.title: Settings
theme.file: VS Code color theme JSON or VSIX file
theme.help: Edit this VS Code color-theme JSON, then apply it. Omitted colors use the light or dark defaults. Loaded files are never modified.
theme.saved: The theme is saved in application preferences. You can copy this JSON into a VS Code color-theme file.
error.themeHeader: Use a VS Code color theme with an optional name and type: dark, light, hcDark or hcLight.
error.themeColors: Theme colors must be hex values (#RGB, #RGBA, #RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA).
error.themeSyntax: Invalid TextMate or semantic color rule. Check scopes, colors and font styles.
error.themeJson: The theme is not valid JSON. Comments and trailing commas are supported.
error.themeSize: Theme files may be up to 2 MiB; theme packages and their extracted data may be up to 24 MiB.
error.themeRead: Could not read the selected theme file. Select an accessible local JSON file and try again.
settings.languageServerVersion: Compatible version: {version}. No tools are downloaded automatically.
error.alreadyOpen: The destination is open in another tab. Choose a different file or close that tab first.
error.nameExists: A file or folder with that name already exists. Choose a different name; existing files will not be overwritten.
error.invalidName: Use a single file or folder name without path separators, reserved names or characters, or a trailing space or dot.
error.trashUnavailable: Recoverable deletion is unavailable for this location. On Windows, use a local fixed drive; network and removable locations are not supported.
error.fileOperationBusy: Wait for the current file operation to finish, then try again.
error.fileOperationChanged: An affected editor changed while confirming this operation. No files were moved. Try again after reviewing your edits.
error.fileOperationRetained: Files were moved, but an editor changed during the operation. Its original buffer has been kept. Use Save As to preserve those edits.
error.notFound: The file or folder no longer exists.
error.permissionDenied: Access denied or path outside the selected workspace.
error.conflict: The file changed on disk. Reload it or use Save As to preserve your edits.
error.encoding: This file could not be decoded as text. Check its encoding.
error.encodingInvalid: The file contains invalid bytes for this encoding. Reopen it using a different encoding.
error.encodingLossy: This encoding cannot represent every character. The file was not changed. Save with UTF-8 or another Unicode encoding instead.
error.encodingUnknown: This text encoding is not supported.
error.binaryFile: This appears to be a binary file, so it cannot be opened as text.
error.fileTooLarge: This file exceeds the 128 MiB text editing limit (on disk or after decoding).
encoding.title: File Encoding
encoding.detail: Reopen reads the file again using the selected encoding. Save converts the current text and writes it using that encoding. Characters that cannot be represented will not be replaced or discarded.
encoding.detected: This encoding was detected automatically. Click to reopen with a different encoding or convert the file.
editor.largeFile: Large file mode: language analysis, syntax highlighting, formatting, folding, word wrap and the minimap are disabled to keep editing responsive. Save, undo and text search within this file remain available.
error.settingsInvalid: Saved settings could not be read. Repair preferences.json in the application data folder.
error.noWorkspace: Open a file or folder first.
error.missingTool: A required Pawn tool is missing. Prepare the pinned tools or configure an external executable.
error.lspStopped: The language server stopped. Use Restart Language Server to reconnect.
error.lspStartTimeout: The language server did not initialize in time. Check the selected executable in Settings.
error.toolChecksum: The bundled language server failed checksum verification. Prepare the pinned tools again or repair the installation.
error.toolTimeout: The selected language server did not report its version in time. Choose a compatible pawnlsp in Settings.
error.toolOutputLimit: The selected executable returned excessive version output. Choose a compatible pawnlsp in Settings.
error.toolProbe: The selected executable could not report its version. Choose a compatible pawnlsp in Settings.
error.toolVersion: Expected pawnlsp {expected}, but the executable reports {actual}. Choose a compatible version in Settings.
error.unsupportedEdit: This language action requires a file operation or confirmation the editor cannot apply yet. No source edits were applied.
error.invalidLanguageEdit: The language server returned an invalid edit range. No edits were applied.
error.watchFailed: File watching failed. Use Refresh Explorer or Reload from Disk to check for external changes.
build.invalidArtifact: The compiler did not produce a valid AMX artifact. Review the output below.
error.compilerArguments: Unsupported compiler options or constants. Use the configured include folders and documented compiler options. The IDE controls the entry point, working directory and AMX output; response files and output-redirection options are not supported.
activity.title: Primary views
scm.title: Source Control
scm.head: HEAD
scm.compareStaged: HEAD → index. These are the changes included in a commit.
scm.compareBuffer: Index → unsaved editor buffer. Save the file before staging these edits.
scm.unsupported: Text comparison is unavailable for binary files, unsupported encodings, submodules or unresolved conflicts. Open a conflicted file to resolve it, then stage the result.
scm.noWorkspace: Open a repository folder to use Source Control.
scm.diskNotice: Stage saved files; commit staged changes.
scm.noRemote: No remote is configured. Add a remote with Git to enable push and pull.
scm.hooksNotice: Explicit Git actions use your Git configuration, hooks and filters. Authentication uses installed Git credential helpers; terminal prompts are disabled.
scm.undoNotice: Move the current branch back one commit and keep all changes staged. This rewrites local history. Do not use it on a shared commit.
scm.amendNotice: Replace the last commit with the current index and this message. This rewrites local history. Do not amend a shared commit.
scm.stashNotice: Save tracked and untracked changes in a stash and remove them from the working tree. Save unsaved editor buffers first.
scm.confirmNotice: Continue with this Git operation? Branch changes and pulls preserve local changes when Git can do so safely. Unmerged branches are not deleted. Dropping a stash permanently removes it.
error.gitMissing: Git is not installed or is not on PATH. Install Git, then restart the IDE.
error.gitRepository: This folder is not a Git working tree. Open an existing repository, or initialize it with Git first.
error.gitScope: Open the Git repository root as the workspace to use Source Control.
error.gitFailed: Git could not complete the operation. Review Git output for details.
error.gitCancelled: Git was cancelled. Refresh and review the repository; completed changes are not rolled back.
error.gitTimeout: Git exceeded the five-minute time limit. Review the repository before retrying.
error.gitOutputLimit: Git output or file content exceeds the 8 MiB display limit.
error.gitPath: This path is outside the repository or uses an unsupported link or filename.
error.gitChanged: The repository changed. Refresh Source Control and retry.
error.gitReference: Choose a valid branch, tag, stash or configured remote.
error.gitMessage: Enter a valid commit or stash message.
error.gitBusy: Another Git operation is running. Wait for it or cancel it first.
error.gitDirty: Save or close unsaved editor buffers before changing branches, pulling or stashing. Your edits have been preserved.
error.historyUpdateFailed: The file operation succeeded, but recent-file history could not be saved. Your files and editor tabs reflect the completed change.
scm.authFailure: Git authentication or repository access was denied. Sign in with your configured Git credential helper and check repository permissions. See Git output for details.
scm.certificateFailure: Git could not verify the remote certificate. Check the remote URL and your Git certificate configuration; do not disable certificate verification.
scm.pullDiverged: The local and remote branches have diverged. Fast-forward pull cannot continue. Reconcile the branches with Git, then retry.
scm.pushRejected: The remote rejected this push. Pull remote changes or review its branch rules and Git output before retrying.
scm.connectionFailure: Git could not access the remote repository. Check the remote URL, network connection and repository availability, then retry.
help.description: A desktop IDE for Pawn and open.mp.
help.author: Amyr Ahmady
help.builtWith: Built with Tauri, React, Monaco Editor, xterm.js, pawnlsp and the open.mp compiler. Thanks to their contributors.
help.icons: File icons: Seti UI by Jesse Weed and Microsoft (MIT). Control icons: Codicons by Microsoft and contributors (CC BY 4.0), used without modification. Source: https://github.com/microsoft/vscode-codicons. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/.
help.support: If ompide makes your work easier, you can support its development.
error.openLinkFailed: The link could not be opened. Check your default browser and try again.
terminal.title: Terminal
terminal.empty: Choose a shell and select + to start a terminal in the workspace folder, or your home folder when no workspace is open. Ctrl+Shift+C copies a selection; Ctrl+Shift+V pastes. Hiding the panel keeps sessions running.
terminal.noShells: No supported shell was found. Install PowerShell or use the system shell, then restart the IDE.
error.terminalFailed: The terminal operation failed. Check that the selected shell is installed and the starting folder is accessible.
error.terminalShellMissing: The selected shell is no longer installed. Restart the IDE to refresh shell profiles.
error.terminalWorkspaceChanged: The workspace changed before the terminal started. Create a new terminal in the current workspace.
error.terminalLimit: Eight terminals are already open. Close one before creating another.
error.terminalClosed: This terminal has closed. Create a new terminal to continue.
error.terminalInput: Terminal input could not be sent. Wait for the shell to respond before pasting more text.
theme.previewHelp: Use ↑ and ↓ to preview, Enter to keep, or Escape to cancel.
theme.onlineHelp: Searches Open VSX. Select a result to download its color themes; extension code is never run. Showing up to 30 results.
theme.empty: No matching themes. Import a theme or search Open VSX.
error.themeInclude: A theme include is missing, cyclic or outside the supplied files. Import the complete theme folder or VSIX package.
error.themePackage: This package does not contain readable VS Code color themes. Import a theme JSON file or a theme extension VSIX.
error.themeRegistry: Could not load themes from Open VSX. Check your connection and try again, or import a local theme.
error.themeChecksum: The theme download failed its checksum check. Download it again.
error.themeLibrarySize: The theme library is full (64 themes or 8 MiB). Remove an installed theme before adding another.
